tables.name: Population Wealth
tables.description: Modified by Condition and Hardship Type/Outcome. Modifies Crime. Consider how the village's resources affect its wealth.

results.name: Destitute
results.description: Most of the population consistently lacks the barest essentials of what they need to survive. (-2 to crime roll)

results.name: Impoverished
results.description: Around half of the population struggles to carve out even a meager existence. (-1 to crime roll)

results.name: Average
results.description: Most of the population have enough to live a modest life. (+0 to crime roll)

results.name: Prosperous
results.description: Most of the population has enough to live a good life and, of them, a fair amount can even live comfortably. (-1 to crime roll)

results.name: Wealthy
results.description: The villagers are well off, perhaps even able to indulge once in a while. (-2 to crime roll)

results.name: Affluent
results.description: The villagers have plenty of disposable income and want for absolutely nothing. (-3 to crime roll)
